flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties (daily and monthly schedules only), framework/workflows/hstreport (HST report, not DIP/MID and without the requested columns), toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (MID/DIP PS-ed); ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists (ReportListTS commented out, ReportListReminder generic download), pages/Dashboard (empty). No quarterly DIP/MID report code in the six repos.
note: The story asks for a quarterly report listing notices temporarily suspended under a specific code, with notice number, name, entity, address, offence date and time, car park and amount payable, routed to the officer dashboard and downloadable. No code: no quarterly schedule, no DIP/MID report, the requested columns are missing from the nearest report (HST), and the dashboard is empty. The TS Reports screen (UI) exists but is inside a comment block. The TS premise also differs because DIP/MID use PS. No relevant ticket. Story status: Requirement given - Gen flow.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The quarterly DIP/MID report is not in the code (only other daily and monthly reports). Ask URA to confirm scope or mark as a gap.

steps.step: DIP/MID notices are already automatically temporarily suspended under a specific suspension code and period (result of OCMS14.5)
steps.detail: There is no temporary suspension for DIP/MID. At the Toppan RR3/DR3 stage, vehicles with vehicleRegistrationType I (Military) or D (Diplomatic) are removed from the letter run (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1979-1993), then applyPsSuspensionForMidDipVehicles calls psHelper.processPS (PermanentSuspensionHelper) with code PS-MID or PS-DIP (ToppanUploadHelper.java:749-777, called at :2014). That is a permanent suspension with no period or duration parameter. MID/DIP are also treated as PS reasons (SuspensionProcessingHelper.java:111-113). Same fact as OCMS14.5 (sibling story).

steps.step: OCMS runs the report quarterly (every three months)
steps.detail: The only report schedules are daily (cron.dailyreport.schedule=0 0 8 * * ?, cron-schedules-prod.properties:255) and monthly (cron.monthlyreport.schedule=0 30 8 1 * ?, :275). There is no three-month cron expression, and no property or job named quarterly in the six repos. The existing report jobs are Payment Exception, Daily Paid, RIP Hirer/Driver, HST, Unclaimed, Furnish Daily and Classified Vehicle (VIP), not a DIP/MID report.

steps.step: The report lists the notices temporarily suspended under the specific suspension code
steps.detail: There is no report for DIP/MID notices or any other code named by the story. The nearest are the HST report (HstReportServiceImpl.checkAndGenerateReports, HstReportServiceImpl.java:205-222, called from the daily job DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:99), which covers HST IDs only and is only generated when new MHA/DataHive results exist, and the TS Reports screen that lists TS suspended notices (ReportListTS.tsx:38-43), but the TS tab sits inside a comment block in ReportList.tsx:147-201 and is not shown. There is no per-suspension-code filter and no quarterly period.

steps.step: The report contains notice number, name, entity, address, offence date and time, car park and amount payable
steps.detail: No report has this combination of columns for TS-ed notices. The nearest HST report compares MHA/DataHive addresses (HstReportServiceImpl.java:258-275), and the HstReportConfig column setup only has 10 columns: S/N, Offender ID, Offender Name, Address, Notice Numbers, Total Suspended Notices, HST Created Date, First/Latest Suspension Date, Status (HstReportConfig.java:49-60). Neither contains offence date and time, car park or amount payable (grep for Car Park/Amount in the hstreport package finds nothing).

steps.step: The report is routed to the Special Notice Processing Officer dashboard
steps.detail: The staff portal Dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:21-31). Other reports in the system are sent by email to OIC recipients (for example RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:103-106), but there is no delivery or routing for this quarterly DIP/MID report.

steps.step: The officer downloads the report for reference
steps.detail: A generic report download mechanism exists (POST download/blob in ReportListReminder.tsx:42-60; OCMS_REPORT_RIP grants /v1/download/blob in api-authorization.properties:123-124), but it serves other reports. Because the quarterly DIP/MID report does not exist, there is no file to download for this story.
